console.welcome_system: [SYSTEM] piDots ready. Local connection established with SQLite WAL. Active model: qwen3.8-27b (RSS Memory: 52 MB).
console.welcome_agent: Hello, Lyon. The environment is ready to work. Local workspace (/workspace) is mapped and hardware telemetry is stable. What are we building or reviewing today? You can type a task directly, summon another specialist with @coder, or press F1 to open the quick manual.

onboarding.title: WELCOME TO THE PIDOTS OPERATIONAL CONSOLE
onboarding.subtitle: A quick 2-minute tour to master controlling your local edge agents.
onboarding.step1_desc: piDots turns your edge device into a smart workstation. Lightweight async Python monolith running multiple specialists using under 70 MB RAM.
onboarding.step2_desc: Speak directly to bots by typing @coder for code, @muse for docs, and @auditor for command review. The supervisor delegates work with zero extra setup.
onboarding.step3_desc: Files, code diffs, and diagrams appear in the right-side canvas without cluttering the chat. Inspect diffs and restore revisions at any time.
onboarding.step4_desc: Potentially destructive commands (like deleting files or editing system configs) are paused instantly. You review the exact command before granting approval.
onboarding.step5_desc: Fast navigation: F1 opens the manual, Alt+I inspects artifacts, Ctrl+L clears the ticker. Install as PWA on mobile or desktop for full-screen mode.
